# function: evaluate

Parses a DMN definitions document and evaluates the named decision (resolving its DRG dependencies), returning a list of result entries.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    dmn = {
      source = "KamranKhan-Dev/dmn"
    }
  }
}

output "subnet" {
  # Single-result table: index [0] for the object, then the output column.
  value = provider::dmn::evaluate(file("${path.module}/networks.dmn"), "Network Lookup", {
    business_unit = "payments"
    environment   = "prod"
  })[0].subnet_id
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
evaluate(definitions string, decision_name string, inputs dynamic) dynamic
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `definitions` (String) The DMN XML document, e.g. file("decision.dmn").
1. `decision_name` (String) The name (or id) of the decision to evaluate.
1. `inputs` (Dynamic) An object of input variables keyed by the decision's input names.
